project: ASTRAEA — COSMIC PULSE (Team 02 Backend & Astronomy Audit)

taxonomy_definitions.verified_real_data: Traced to an identifiable authoritative upstream astronomical archive or catalog with cryptographic or header verification.
taxonomy_definitions.derived_real_data: Calculated deterministically from verified observations using documented astronomical processing.
taxonomy_definitions.heuristic_estimate: Generated using an engineering approximation, composite formula, or empirical rule of thumb.
taxonomy_definitions.synthetic_data: Artificially generated arrays or FITS structures for deterministic unit testing.
taxonomy_definitions.mock_or_placeholder_data: Intentionally used in place of live data for offline fallback or UI wiring.
taxonomy_definitions.hardcoded_configuration: Manually supplied astronomical or system parameter whose literature/catalog source is documented.
taxonomy_definitions.unverified_data: Origin or live availability cannot be established offline without live archive access.
taxonomy_definitions.unsupported_or_fabricated_claim: Presented as factual observation counts, uniform detector distributions, or confirmed discoveries without evidence.

detected_fabrications_and_remediations.description: Hardcoded irsa_audit blocks and data_status='verified_available' across all 5 benchmark targets (barnard: 386, eps_ind_b: 486, wise0855: 263, rw_aur: 342, r_dra: 578) introduced between backup snapshots config.py.bak_be15 and config.py.
forensic_evidence: rw_aur reported by_detector={1: 57, 2: 57, 3: 57, 4: 57, 5: 57, 6: 57} (6*57=342) and visit_groups_30d={D1: 3..D6: 3}, an artificial uniform distribution.
eps_ind_b, rw_aur, and r_dra have zero cached FITS cutouts or SIA JSON files in backend/cache/ and were never queried in notebooks/NASA_backend_exploration.ipynb.
API_CONTRACT_AND_SCIENTIFIC_VALIDATION.md claimed these counts came from spherex_dr1 + spherex_qr2, whereas spherex_qr2 returns 0 rows on IRSA (replaced by spherex_dr1 + spherex_qr3).

wise0855 total_observations=263 and baseline_days=373.6 were copied from a single-collection (spherex_dr1) notebook cell, while per-detector counts {1:37, 2:48, 3:46, 4:38, 5:49, 6:45} were guessed so D5+D6=94.
detected_fabrications_and_remediations.remediation: Removed fabricated static irsa_audit blocks and replaced data_status='verified_available' with 'verified_local_cache_subset' for barnard (backed by 30 SHA-256 verified FITS files) and 'unverified_offline' for eps_ind_b, wise0855, rw_aur, and r_dra, plus reproducible audit_all_benchmark_targets().

detected_fabrications_and_remediations.description: Difference-image dipole/peak detections within 12 arcsec of a benchmark coordinate were labeled 'Confirmed Benchmark Object (Barnard's Star)' without independent astrometric/photometric confirmation.
detected_fabrications_and_remediations.remediation: Relabeled to 'Benchmark Coordinate Match — Unconfirmed (<name>)' with association_type='benchmark_coordinate_match_unconfirmed', independent_confirmation=False, human_reviewed=False, and is_calibrated_probability=False.

detected_fabrications_and_remediations.description: All 30 real Barnard's Star frames in sample_barnard_response.json were labeled with synthetic collection='spherex_qr2' because the offline generator script hardcoded 'spherex_qr2'.
detected_fabrications_and_remediations.remediation: Cryptographically verified all 30 MD5 cache filenames against their exact IRSA IBE access_urls (19 spherex_dr1, 11 spherex_qr3) and regenerated sample_barnard_response.json with true collections.

detected_fabrications_and_remediations.description: Propagated coordinates were computed at default to_mjd=61000.0 (2025-11-21, J2025.8877) while API fields were labeled ra_2026 and dec_2026 without epoch metadata.
detected_fabrications_and_remediations.remediation: Set DEFAULT_REFERENCE_MJD = 61041.0 (exact J2026.0 = 2026-01-01T00:00:00 UTC) for ra_2026/dec_2026 and added explicit propagated_to_mjd, propagated_epoch_jyear, catalog_epoch_jyear, and pm_convention metadata.

detected_fabrications_and_remediations.description: Upstream IRSA SIA exceptions were caught with print() and converted into empty lists, causing build_cube to report error_code='no_observations_found' when IRSA was unreachable, and caching partial multi-collection failures as complete results.
detected_fabrications_and_remediations.remediation: Added per-collection status tracking (complete_with_observations, complete_empty, partial_failure, upstream_failure), restricted SIA caching strictly to complete=True queries, and returned HTTP 503 upstream_service_unavailable when upstream archive queries fail.
